definitions.gloss: palpation; examination by feeling with the hands
definitions.explanation: A medical examination technique in which a doctor presses or feels the body with their hands to assess organs, detect abnormalities, or check for tenderness or swelling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腹部|ふくぶ}→腹部：21667_fukubu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{触診|しょくしん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{触診|しょくしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A lump was found during palpation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{視診|ししん}・⟦{聴診|ちょうしん}→聴診：29063_choushin⟧・{触診|しょくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The internist conducted the examination using a combination of visual inspection, auscultation, and palpation.

notes:
{触|しょく} means to touch; {診|しん} means to examine medically. One of the standard clinical examination methods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {触診|しょくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to palpate
- {触診|しょくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform palpation
- ⟦{腹部|ふくぶ}→腹部：21667_fukubu⟧{触診|しょくしん}: abdominal palpation

RELATED EXAMINATION TYPES:
- {視診|ししん}: visual inspection
- ⟦{聴診|ちょうしん}→聴診：29063_choushin⟧: auscultation (listening with stethoscope)
- ⟦{打診|だしん}→打診：05831_dashin⟧: percussion (tapping to assess sound)
